entity.name: Vivodepot GmbH
entity.description: Vivodepot GmbH (Berlin, Germany) develops and maintains Vivodepot, an open-source application (EUPL-1.2) in which people keep the records of their own life in one encrypted file they hold themselves.

projects.name: Vivodepot
projects.description: Each edition of Vivodepot is a single HTML file that runs offline in the browser, without an account; no server holds the records. People keep the records of their own life across thirteen areas, encrypted client-side (AES-256-GCM), and hand recipients extracts, among them HL7 FHIR (International Patient Summary, validated with the HL7 validator), vCard and iCalendar. An open specification of the underlying data format with a standalone validator is planned, so that other implementations and institutions can build on it.

channels.description: Bank transfer to Vivodepot GmbH. Account details on request via info@vivodepot.de.

plans.name: Open format and validator
plans.description: Specification, standalone validator and test corpus for the open data format, and keeping the reference implementation conformant.
